summary.text: Charlotte DiLorenzo is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 10, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She previously served in the House representing Rockingham 10 and worked in property management and housing compliance.

paragraphs.text: Charlotte DiLorenzo was born in Lynn, Massachusetts, and earned a B.A. in legal services from the University of Massachusetts at Boston in 1982.

Her career experience includes working as a property management administrator with Pine Street Inn, Inc., the director of compliance with Housing Management Resources, and a senior property manager with The Housing Partnership.
DiLorenzo has served on the Newmarket Housing Authority Executive Board, the Rockingham County Executive Committee, and the Newmarket Advisory Committee of Racial Equity, Inclusion, and Human Rights.

DiLorenzo was a member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from 2016 to 2024, representing Rockingham 10, and was assigned to the House Judiciary Committee in the 2019-2020, 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 sessions.
She did not run for re-election in 2024.
DiLorenzo advanced from the Democratic primary for Rockingham 10 on September 8, 2026.
